doc: Rebuilds `other`'s per-slot state (clearing/releasing 3 fixed slot ids via func_80042B68/func_80042518), conditionally OR's a flag word on `other` when other->f25==0 && other->f13!=0, snapshots the first 0x4C bytes of `other` into `self` via func_8003DB6C, then derives two byte slot-indices in `self` (via func_800422A8 against a fixed base address 0x80010248, elem size 4, count 0x14) from other->f4C and other->f50, and finally copies other->f54 into self->f50.

func_800422A8(unsigned int a0, unsigned int a1, unsigned short a2, unsigned short a3) -> short, matched
